t: Smart light bulb works on a normal wall switch without an internet connection (not suitable for use with dimmer switches) and also Wi-Fi. Once connected to Wi-Fi, colour and white colour temperatures can be changed through more than 100 variations and timers can be set via the Calex Smart remote control and free app. Dimmable via app and remote control. Can be connected with smart home assistant speakers for voice activation. Supplied in card/paper packaging suitable for kerbside recycling.
b: Works with - Amazon Alexa - Google Home - iOS App - Android App
Supplied in Kerbside Recyclable Card/Paper Packaging
